metadata.description: Missal with notated chants, central Italy (Abruzzi), late 10th or 11th century. Central Italian neumes without a staff. The gradual of the octave of Christmas (1 January), f. 4r, left column.
metadata.title: Missale
metadata.transcription: Read sign by sign from the Vatican Library's photograph of f. 4r by two independent readers, October 2026; the neumes written on into the margin given to their syllables from the page and the other witnesses; see research/diffusa-est/staff-readings/README.md.
